0022600087.text: Both the Brooklyn Nets and Charlotte Hornets open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Nets hosting. Brooklyn is without Joshua Jefferson, who is listed as out with a back issue, while Charlotte's Coby White, Grant Williams, Grayson Allen, Kon Knueppel, Kylan Boswell and Moussa Diabate are all listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. In the 2025-26 season series the Nets lost 1-2, including a 117-86 defeat in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Brooklyn a 40% chance to win.
